chunks: The number of his works whose names we have identified amounts to more than fifty books in various branches of Islam.
ai.seo_question: How many books did Shaykh al-Tusi (Sheikh al-Taifa) author according to the introduction of Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This sentence is drawn from the biographical introduction to Tahdhib al-Ahkam (Chapter 15: 'Sheikh al-Taifa in Brief'), recording that the identifiable works of Shaykh al-Ta'ifa Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Tusi (d. 460 AH/1067 CE) exceed fifty books. It underscores his encyclopaedic scholarly output spanning the full breadth of Islamic disciplines.
